title: [LOGGED OUT] Phone burger menu on Home shows all items and closes

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser with phone emulation (iPhone 14 size, 390x844) and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
If an "Add It to Home Screen" banner is shown at the bottom, close it with its X button (never click its "Claim").
steps.saw: Clicked X (Close pwa banner); banner gone

steps.text: Click the green burger button at the top left.
Does the menu show the LUDUS logo, a red close (x) button and "Home", "Store", "Reward chain", "Clan reward", "Loyalty shop", then "Login"?
steps.saw: Menu shows LUDUS logo, red X at top right, then Home, Store, Reward chain, Clan reward, Loyalty shop, divider, Login
Home colour rgb(249, 223, 66) (yellow); other items white

steps.text: Click the red close (x) button of the menu.

steps.saw: Menu closed; Home page with green burger button and Login visible
